# Remote Control Agent v0.1.33

Issue #39 — first three-platform candidate containing owner-one-shot-v1 for Windows x64, Linux x64 and Linux ARM64.

- Immutable, architecture-specific release archives with SHA-256 recorded in SHA256SUMS.txt.
- Device-bound, owner-approved, single-use remote upgrade admission.
- Platform-native staged upgrade and bounded rollback verification.
- Preserves original paired identity and operation receipts.

This Release makes the reviewed Agent assets available. It does **not** activate remote upgrades or authorize any live device switch. Production Worker pin activation, owner Access verification, and real Windows/WSL2 upgrade acceptance are separate gates.

Candidate CI: https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/40480980591
